summary: GeoJSON geometry type for a zone polygon.
businessRules: type defines: Type of the geoJSON geometry. Should always be Polygon or MultiPolygon.
Valid options: Polygon, MultiPolygon. Each affects solver behavior differently.
Must stay consistent with: zones.geometry.coordinates. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: test with type set to "Polygon"
Positive: test with type set to "MultiPolygon"
